            f.ds,

            f.avg_rsk_lmt_rate_hug_6m,
            f.avg_rsk_lmt_rate_hug_3m_suc,

            f.avg_rsk_lmt_rate_hug_12m_suc,
            f.avg_rsk_lmt_rate_hug_12m,
            f.avg_rsk_lmt_rate_dcp_6m_suc,
            f.avg_rsk_lmt_rate_dcp_6m,
            f.avg_rsk_lmt_rate_dcp_3m_suc,

            f.avg_rsk_lmt_rate_bt_ch_12m_suc,
            f.avg_rsk_lmt_rate_bt_ch_12m,
            row_number() over(partition by s.${s_topic_field} order by f.ds desc) as rn
        FROM ${sample_table} s
        LEFT JOIN (
                    SELECT
                        *
                    FROM
                        pdm_risk.pdm_risk_dz_model_account_lmt_feature_sample_final_df
                    WHERE
                        to_date(to_date(ds,'yyyyMMdd')) >= ${min_ds}
                    AND
                        ds <= ${max_ds}
                    ) f
        ON
            s.${s_topic_field} = f.uid
        AND
            datediff(to_date(s.${s_mdl_dte_field}),to_date(f.ds ,'yyyyMMdd')) = 0
    ) o  WHERE rn=1;
